messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: "queue_backlog_high" for service: inference-queue-usw2
pagerduty: Page: INC1234567 - Severity: P1 - affected: inference-frontend -> Queues piling up > 10k
mira: ack
mira: looking
alex: i'm seeing 6k pending reqs on the main dispatcher, latency spikes to 1.8s token
sam: checking HPA/KEDA, could be metrics drop
ryan: i spun up a probe, metrics from prometheus show keda_scaledObjects is reporting 0 for the scaler
mira: command: ```kubectl get scaledobject -n inference -o wide``` -> scaled object shows triggers: prometheus, lastSeen N/A
alex: HPA targets still at 1, desiredReplicas=2, currentReplicas=2
sam: trying manual scale for now: ```kubectl scale deploy inference-worker --replicas=8 -n inference``` :wrench:
oncall-rotation: doing node spinup in cloud console (requesting burst capacity pool)
eng-sre: heads up, autoscaler metrics ingestion lagged earlier after prometheus restart, could be the cause
mira: after manual scale: pending queue dropped from 6k -> 900 in ~40s :chart_with_downwards_trend:
alex: good, latency dropping to 600ms
sam: PD note: will hold page for 15m, escalate if > 3k pending again
ryan: filing follow-up: creating ticket INF-2317 with root-cause guess: KEDA prometheus trigger failed due to missing scrape labels after prometheus rollout
mira: mitigation steps: 1) revert prometheus rollout 2) patch scaledobject to include fallback metric 3) add alert for scaledobject_lastSeen
mira: assign to eng-sre+infra for postmortem, notify support for customer impact review
sam: support: customer-impact? any 500 errors surfaced to customers?
oncall-rotation: we saw increased 429s and queued requests delayed; product metrics show ~0.5% error spike for embeddings-heavy customers
eng-sre: agreed retain logs, start timeline. we will plan rollback and hotfix; scheduled manual autoscaler watch until patch
mira: closing ack; will update thread when stable
incident-bot: INC1234567 status: acknowledged -> resolved? (awaiting final confirmation)
